subject: How studios turn cold leads into clients with AI
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most cold leads don’t convert because nobody has a system to warm them up — not because they weren’t interested.


Here’s what’s working right now: fitness studios are feeding their cold lead lists into a multi-step AI sequence that sends a mix of personalized texts and emails over 7–10 days. The messages reference the lead’s specific goal — weight loss, strength, flexibility — whatever they flagged when they opted in. That single personalization is what separates it from a generic blast. Studios running this at {{business_name}}’s scale are seeing 15–25% of cold leads re-engage and book a consultation — leads they would have otherwise let go dead. The sequence runs automatically every time a new cold lead hits the CRM, and the only cost is the tools you’re likely already paying for.


The setup takes one afternoon. The results compound every week.
